notes: Posted 1 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as marked (s): TDIGWATT (This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further), Boonta Eve Podrace, Casino, I'm Sorry, Secret Plans and Sebulba's Podracer; they count toward the total. Start Your Engines! is not marked (s), but the strategy calls the start 'basic for a podracing deck' (I'm Sorry started in place of Watto's Box), so it is set as the starting interrupt.

Cloud City sites dested the Dark pages: 'Cloud City' = Bespin: Cloud City (Dark), 'Casino' = Cloud City: Casino (Dark), 'Chasm Walkway' = Cloud City: Chasm Walkway (Dark), 'Carbo Chamber' = Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber (Dark); 'Tat PR Arena' = Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark).

Posted 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Fett w/ Gun' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'IG-88 w/ Gun' and '4-lom w/ Gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun and 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Mara Jade' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (the deck plays Mara Jade's Lightsaber).

Posted 'I have You Know' dested I Have You Now; 'Uncertain is the Future/Sense' dested the Dark combo Sense & Uncertain Is The Future; 'Kiss a Wookie' dested the Dark interrupt I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee; 'Dist in the Force' dested A Disturbance In The Force (the strategy's 'errated ... once per game' note fits it).
Secret Plans is a 2001 Effect (not a Defensive Shield).
Boonta Eve Podrace dested the Dark page Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark).
